description: Extend an inbox you own by one, four or twenty-four hours, keeping its address and its mail. Paid in stablecoins with x402 like create_inbox. Needs the inbox id and its secret. An inbox cannot be paid for more than 72 hours ahead.

duration.description: how long the inbox lasts: 1h, 4h or 24h

inbox_id.description: the inbox id returned by create_inbox

secret.description: the inbox secret returned by create_inbox
